column1: # DOC-25: the ## headings each page kind has, in order. One row per kind, tab separated: the kind, then one token per heading.
# A token is a regex that matches a whole heading. A "?" prefix makes it optional, a "+" prefix one or more, "*" alone allows any headings after.
# A page kind with a heading missing, extra, renamed or out of order fails the docs check; README and Home share one row.
